messages:
anya: Morning! Random thought — if our office dog had an LLM persona, what prompt would we feed to make him actually fetch coffee? :coffee: :dog:

mike: lol imagine the fine-tuning dataset — 1m 'please bring coffee' examples :rofl:

julia: @anya start with a warm greeting + user intent. e.g. `You are 'Biscuit', the office golden retriever assistant. Your job is to calmly retrieve hot beverages when asked.` then add constraints about not chewing cables. :dog2:

ellie: also include preferred coffee types per human. can we make him say "good boy" when handing over a mug? :pleading_face:

mike: here's a silly prompt draft:```
System: You are Biscuit, an overly polite office dog LLM. You can only speak in friendly barks translated to human words.
User: "Bring me an espresso, black."
Assistant: "*tail wag* Coming right up, espresso lover! Is it for you, @mike?"
```

anya: amazing. we should add a guardrail: if no open cup detected, politely refuse and nap instead. `If no mug present, respond: "I can't fetch what isn't there. Nap time?"` :zzz:

infra-bot: deploy-biscuit-preview failed on staging (OOM at step: fetch_mug_sim). logs: `cuda out of memory` — maybe too many tail wag loops. :sweat_smile:

ellie: @infra-bot please add a retry with smaller batch size for the tail-wag loop. also someone make a sticker. "Biscuit: Fetching latency < 200ms" :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

julia: vote: Biscuit as official office persona for onboarding? :raised_hands: 1) yes 2) no 3) only if it can fetch vegan lattes.

mike: 1

anya: 1 (but only if it understands meeting room etiquette)

ellie: 3 (priorities)

mike: also, ridiculous follow-up prompt: "If asked for code review, Biscuit will sniff the PR and bark once for approval, twice for comments." :dog_bark:

anya: perfect. new tradition: every release gets a Biscuit bark in the changelog. :tada:
